newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan shares stable in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordan shares stable in quiet trade.

text.p: Shares on Jordan's stock market were stable on Sunday in quiet trade boosted by transactions in major banking stock, brokers said.
The Amman Financial Market 60-share index rose 0.03 percent to 152.78 points in business worth 2.84 million dinars ($4.01 million).
Brokers said they expected the market to shrug off Saturday's political jitters to focus more on fundamentals, as traders look ahead to annual results.
"We are getting to the end of the year and people will start looking at the performances," analyst Mohamad Abdullah said. "There should be a slight rise to reflect those performances."
Sunday's turnover was dominated by trade in Industrial Development Bank and The Housing Bank, which accounted for over two million dinars of turnover.
Jordan Petroleum Refinery, was the next busiest share, rising 0.02 dinars to 9.60 dinars.
Falling shares outnumbered gainers on Sunday by 20 to 14, with 12 trading but closing unchanged.
The private Pearl Index of 45 best-traded shares shed 0.13 percent to 82.41 points, 13.72 percent down on last year.
